**Finding submitted: deviation (Section 14 / p0048).**

Contrary to the planner's expectation that insurance was absent, an insurance clause does exist — it is buried as unnumbered item 14 inside Section 7 rather than appearing in the outline. It covers:

- Workers' compensation at statutory limits ✓
- CGL USD 1M ✓ (no 2M aggregate — noted only)
- E&O USD 1M ✓ at fallback (preferred is 2M — noted only)
- Certificates/evidence on request ✓

The material gap is **cyber/privacy coverage, which is entirely absent**. Contractor receives Company Confidential Information ("documents, software, reports, data, records" — p0038) and may access Company computer systems and work at Company facilities (p0007), so cyber cover is squarely engaged. Because the fallback requires E&O 1M **and** cyber 2M, a total absence of cyber fails the fallback on a material term.

The redline is a single in-line insertion adding cyber liability at the preferred USD 5M, conditioned on Contractor processing Company data, leaving the negotiated CGL/E&O/WC schedule and certificate mechanics untouched. The comment offers USD 2M as a fallback.
